title: Apple to base next Siri and Apple Intelligence models on Google Gemini (~$1B a year reported)

sources.quote: Apple and Google have entered into a multi-year collaboration under which the next generation of Apple Foundation Models will be based on Google's Gemini models and cloud technology.
Apple will pay Google about $1 billion a year to use a model with 1.2 trillion parameters.
The price tag is rumored to be roughly $1 billion a year, though neither company has confirmed terms.

explain: Apple is paying Google to use its Gemini AI models as the base for the next Siri and Apple Intelligence. The deal is multi-year; Bloomberg reported Apple would pay about $1 billion per year (the amount shown is one year, not the total), and neither company has confirmed the price.
